en.headline: Customs seizes 6.1 tonnes of drugs worth HK$1.4 billion in summer airport operation
en.dek: A four-month joint campaign with mainland and overseas agencies detected 424 cases and arrested 150 people, many of them young adults recruited during the holiday peak.
body: Hong Kong Customs seized about 6.1 tonnes of suspected narcotics with an estimated market value of more than HK$1.4 billion and arrested 150 people during a large-scale anti-trafficking operation at Hong Kong International Airport between May and August.

The campaign, conducted with 21 mainland and overseas law-enforcement agencies, uncovered 424 cases — 118 involving passengers and 306 involving cargo. Cannabis made up nearly 60 per cent of the haul at 3.6 tonnes, followed by 2.2 tonnes of ketamine, 199 kg of cocaine, 60 kg of heroin, 48 kg of methamphetamine and smaller quantities of other substances.

Acting head of the Customs Drug Investigation Bureau Wong Ngar-lun said real-time intelligence exchanges helped intercept consignments before they reached local or international markets. About 70 per cent of those arrested were aged 18 to 40, reflecting attempts by syndicates to recruit younger people, including students, during the summer travel peak.

Airport-related cases and seizure values both rose sharply year-on-year. Customs said it would continue to adjust strategies and strengthen cooperation with overseas partners to counter evolving smuggling methods.

zh.headline: 海關暑期機場緝毒行動檢6.1噸毒品值14億元拘150人
zh.dek: 與內地及海外21個執法機構聯合行動四個月，破424案，約七成被捕者為18至40歲青年。
body: 香港海關在5月至8月期間於香港國際機場展開大型反毒品行動，檢獲約6.1噸懷疑毒品，市值超過14億港元，並拘捕150人。
行動與21個內地及海外執法機構合作，共偵破424宗案件，當中客運渠道118宗、貨運渠道306宗。檢獲毒品中大麻約佔六成，共3.6噸，其次為氯胺酮2.2噸、可卡因199公斤、海洛英60公斤、冰毒48公斤及其他少量毒品。
海關毒品調查科署理首長黃雅倫表示，實時情報交流有助在毒品流入本地或國際市場前作出攔截。被捕人士中約七成年齡介乎18至40歲，反映不法分子趁暑期旅遊高峰招募年輕人包括學生參與跨境販毒。
機場相關案件數目及檢獲毒品價值均較去年同期顯著上升。海關表示將繼續調整策略，加強與海外夥伴合作，以應對不斷轉變的走私手法。
